module.purpose: Implements the React Fiber reconciler host configuration for the ART rendering backend, mapping React tree operations to ART node primitives and event handling.
module.summary: This module is the bridge between React's reconciler and the ART drawing library. It exports the mandatory host config functions (createInstance, appendChild, removeChild, commitUpdate, etc.) that the reconciler calls to mount, update, and unmount ART nodes. Internal helper functions compute scale, font equality, and apply prop differences to ART instances via a pooled Transform. Event listener subscription lifecycle is tracked per instance. Many modern view-transition and suspense APIs are stubbed as no-ops or throw not-implemented to keep the secondary ART renderer minimal.
module.businessContext: Powers React ART rendering; if broken, ART components cannot mount or update in React trees. Secondary to React DOM.

units.name: addEventListeners

detail.name: addEventListeners
preconditions: instance provides _listeners, _subscriptions, and a subscribe method
type is a string identifying an event type
postconditions: instance._listeners[type] is assigned the provided listener
If listener is truthy and instance._subscriptions[type] is absent, instance._subscriptions[type] becomes the result of instance.subscribe(type, createEventHandler(instance), instance)
If listener is falsy and instance._subscriptions[type] exists, that subscription function is invoked and the entry is deleted
invariants: instance._listeners[type] always reflects the most recently passed listener for that type
edgeCases: Listener truthy but subscription already present: no duplicate subscribe call
Listener falsy and no existing subscription: no operation performed
Listener falsy with existing subscription: unsubscribe side-effect and property deletion
stateMutations: instance._subscriptions[type] = subscription handle or removal via delete
detail.summary: Associates an event listener with a given event type on an ART instance, ensuring the instance subscribes to the event via its subscribe method when a listener is present and unsubscribes when the listener is removed.

specTests.then: instance._listeners.click === handler and instance._subscriptions.click is the unsub function and subscribe called with ('click', createEventHandler(instance), instance)

units.name: getScaleY

detail.name: getScaleY
preconditions: node must be a valid React Fiber object
node.memoProps must exist and contain a transform property
transform must be an array whose index 3 holds the Y scale factor
postconditions: Returns a finite number representing the Y-axis scale factor
On failure or missing transform data, returns 1 (the default scale factor)
edgeCases: If node.memoProps.transform is undefined or missing, returns 1
If transform array is shorter than 4 elements, returns 1
If the scale value at index 3 is NaN or not a number, returns 1

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Returns 1 as a safe default when transform data is missing or invalid

detail.summary: Reads the vertical scale factor from a Fiber node's memoProps transform and returns it as a number; used by React-Fiber to determine how the ART renderer should scale an element along the Y axis.

units.name: isSameFont

detail.name: isSameFont
preconditions: newFont and oldFont are objects
newFont and oldFont each contain the properties: fontStyle, fontVariant, fontWeight, and fontFamily
postconditions: Returns true if and only if newFont.fontStyle, newFont.fontVariant, newFont.fontWeight, and newFont.fontFamily are all strictly equal to the corresponding properties on oldFont
edgeCases: If corresponding font properties differ in type or value, returns false
If any font property is undefined or null on either object, strict equality comparison applies, potentially returning false
detail.summary: Compares two font configuration objects by their fontStyle, fontVariant, fontWeight, and fontFamily properties, returning true only when all four fields match.

units.name: applyNodeProps

detail.name: applyNodeProps
preconditions: instance must be a valid ART node instance exposing transformTo, indicate, show, and hide methods, and optionally a blend method
props must be an object containing ART node properties (scale, transform, originX, originY, cursor, title, opacity, visible, and event type keys)
prevProps must be an object (defaults to {}) when not provided
postconditions: If pooledTransform's affine components (xx, yx, xy, yy, x, y) differ from instance's, instance.transformTo(pooledTransform) has been called
If cursor or title prop changed from prevProps, instance.indicate(cursor, title) has been called
If instance.blend exists and opacity prop changed from prevProps, instance.blend(opacity) has been called with 1 substituted for null opacity
If visible prop changed from prevProps, either instance.show() (when null/truthy) or instance.hide() (when falsy) has been called
Event listeners for all EVENT_TYPES keys have been registered on instance via addEventListeners
invariants: Each property is committed to the instance only when its value differs from prevProps
pooledTransform serves as a scratch buffer and must be properly initialized before applying scale
Null opacity defaults to 1 before being passed to instance.blend
edgeCases: prevProps omitted: defaults to {} causing all props to appear changed on first call
props.opacity == null: blend receives 1 instead of null or 0
props.visible == null or truthy: instance.show() is called instead of instance.hide()
props.transform == null: transform is not applied to pooledTransform (only scale is applied)
instance.blend missing: blend/opacity update is skipped entirely via conditional check (instance.blend && ...)
props.visible falsy (0, false, empty string): instance.hide() is called
stateMutations: Mutates instance via transformTo, indicate, blend, show, and hide method calls
Mutates pooledTransform scratch buffer via scale and transform methods
Registers event listeners on instance via addEventListeners
detail.summary: Applies ART node properties (scale, transform, cursor/title indication, opacity/blend, visibility, and event listeners) to an instance, committing each change only when the corresponding prop differs from prevProps.

specTests.then: instance.blend is called with argument 1 (null opacity defaults to 1)
instance.show is called (null visible defaults to showing, not hiding)

units.name: applyRenderableNodeProps

detail.name: applyRenderableNodeProps
preconditions: instance provides fill(props.fill) and stroke(...) methods
props is an object containing visual style fields (fill, stroke, strokeWidth, strokeCap, strokeJoin, strokeDash)
prevProps is an object of previously applied props, defaulting to empty object if omitted
postconditions: instance.fill(props.fill) invoked when fill prop differs from prevProps.fill
instance.stroke(props.stroke, props.strokeWidth, props.strokeCap, props.strokeJoin, props.strokeDash) invoked when any stroke-related prop differs from prevProps
edgeCases: prevProps omitted defaults to {} causing all comparisons to treat previous as undefined
strokeDash change detection is shallow (no deep check)
stateMutations: mutates ART instance render state via fill and stroke method calls
detail.summary: Applies renderable node visual properties (fill and stroke) to an ART instance, updating only those that changed between current and previous props.

units.name: applyShapeProps

detail.name: applyShapeProps
preconditions: instance is an ART shape with a draw method and mutable _prevDelta/_prevPath fields
props is an object that may contain path, width, height
prevProps is an object representing previous props (defaults to empty object)
postconditions: applyRenderableNodeProps is invoked with (instance, props, prevProps)
If path, path.delta, width or height changed relative to prev, instance.draw(path, props.width, props.height) is called and instance._prevDelta/_prevPath are updated
edgeCases: prevProps omitted defaults to {} making prevPath/prevDelta/prevWidth/prevHeight undefined, triggering redraw on first apply
If path reference equal, path.delta equal, and width/height equal, draw is skipped (no state update)
stateMutations: instance draw state via draw() call
detail.summary: Applies shape-specific props (path, width, height) to an ART shape instance, redrawing only when path reference, path delta, or dimensions change.

specTests.then: instance.draw is not called and _prevPath remains p1
instance.draw called with (p2,20,20), instance._prevPath === p2 and instance._prevDelta === 2

units.name: applyTextProps

detail.name: applyTextProps
preconditions: instance is an ART text node exposing a draw method
props and prevProps are objects providing font, alignment, path, and the text string (typically via children)
postconditions: If font, alignment, path, or string changed, instance.draw is invoked with the new values and instance._currentString is set to the string
If no compared prop changed, instance drawing state and _currentString remain untouched
edgeCases: On initial mount prevProps may be an empty object, causing all comparisons to differ and forcing a draw
Changing only non-text props (e.g., fill, stroke) does not trigger draw inside this function
stateMutations: instance.draw(...) mutates ART node render state
detail.summary: Applies text-specific properties (font, alignment, path, and string content) to an ART text instance, triggering a redraw only when those properties differ from previous props.
